name: plutus-funder-research
description: Research alternative business funders and financing brokers, with a focus on merchant cash advances (MCA), asset-based funding, and revenue-based financing.

interface.longDescription: Research alternative business funding through Plutus AI's public directory of funders and financing brokers, focused primarily on merchant cash advances (MCA), asset-based funding, revenue-based financing, and related alternative financing products. Look up companies by name, browse bounded results, and read published profiles with available product information, company-source links and catalog update dates. Compare facts from profiles without treating missing information as confirmed criteria. This read-only research tool does not collect or submit funding applications, contact funders, forward leads, make credit decisions, predict approval, or move money. Confirm current terms directly with the provider; catalog references and update dates do not independently verify every statement.
